MCLA.definition: binary base-cluster hyperedges; pairwise Jaccard meta-graph; recursive METIS into c meta-clusters with base-cluster sizes as vertex weights; mean association collapse; seeded epsilon tie break; argmax assignment

HBGF.definition: unweighted bipartite graph over samples and canonical base clusters; unit membership edges; recursive METIS into c parts; return sample-vertex labels

class_count_rule: c is the benchmark class count derived from y; y is otherwise unavailable to the consensus method
prohibited: no development search or parameter tuning
no BP regeneration, filtering, weighting, or reordering
no paper-label oracle over multiple backends
public_copy_note: Machine path replaced by a portable placeholder; original file hash is recorded in PRIVATE_AUDIT_SOURCE_MAP.csv.
